get.summary: UC1 - Very Popular but Low Rated Books
get.description: Returns books with the highest discrepancy between popularity and quality. Higher values indicate books that are significantly more popular than their rating would suggest. Query parameters are used to filter the candidate set before ranking.

200.description: Paginated list of books with highest popularity-quality discrepancy.

get.summary: UC2 - High Rated but Low Popularity (Hidden Gems)
get.description: Returns books with the lowest discrepancy between popularity and quality. Hidden gems correspond to books where the discrepancy_score are the smallest.

200.description: Paginated list of hidden gem books.

get.description: Computes the statistical correlation between book quality (`star_rating`) and popularity (`num_ratings`) across the selected set of books. Optional filters by genre and publication year can be applied before the correlation is calculated.

Returns yearly aggregated publishing metrics, including the number of books published, average star rating, and total number of ratings. Optional filters by genre and publication year range can be applied.

200.description: Yearly publishing growth metrics successfully computed.

get.description: Compares classic and modern books based on publication year thresholds. The endpoint returns aggregated metrics for each era, including number of books, average star rating, average number of ratings, and total number of ratings.

200.description: Classic vs modern comparison successfully computed.

GenreNameParam.name: genre_name
GenreNameParam.description: Filter by one or more genre names. A book must contain all selected genres.

GenreIdParam.name: genre_id
GenreIdParam.description: Filter by one or more genre IDs. A book must contain all selected genre IDs.

PubYearFromParam.name: pub_year_from
PubYearFromParam.description: Filter books published after or equal to this year.

PubYearToParam.name: pub_year_to
PubYearToParam.description: Filter books published before or equal to this year.

ClassicThresholdParam.name: classic_threshold
ClassicThresholdParam.description: Maximum publication year considered part of the classic era.

ModernThresholdParam.name: modern_threshold
ModernThresholdParam.description: Minimum publication year considered part of the modern era.
